independentEvidenceAdjustments: SEC issuer filing directly identifies Terawatt Infrastructure, Inc., Delaware 2021, previously Pearl Street Operating Company. This corrects the earlier description of the Form D issuer; it does not prove the ultimate parent or the 2018 land-vehicle succession.

Live Vision Ridge investments page visibly places TeraWatt beneath Sustainable Asset Fund III (2021 vintage), without an EXITED label. Its team page names Paul Luce as a current TeraWatt director. These support the existing fund/manager link, not exact stakes, holder identity or continuity of Keyframe/Cyrus.

Form D offering proceeds and the separate property-company offering cannot be equated with the institutional commitment headline or used as a current cap table. The June 2026 company release describes secured debt with an incremental option, not new equity.

The response's separate 2018 land-vehicle formation and 2026 PropCo co-invest assertions lack a returned direct filing URL and were not independently established in this packet; they are not application facts. No company/fund/vehicle merge or new ownership follows from them.

No current issuer-specific equity register, holdings schedule or executed transfer/exit document resolves Keyframe and Cyrus at the cutoff. Retain a precise DEFERRED exception and do not duplicate the company or Vision Ridge row.
